name: Shenzhen Jlc Technology Group Co. Lt
summary: Shenzhen JLC Technology Group Co., Ltd. manufactures PCB proofing and laser steel mesh. Its products include FR-4 hard boards, FPC soft boards, high-frequency boards, thermoelectric separation copper substrates, aluminum substrates and other board types. The firm also provides PCBA proofing/small batch, EDA/CAM industrial software, steel mesh/jig, FA mechanical parts, 3D printing, CNC mechanical intelligent manufacturing, sheet metal processing and other technologies and services. Shenzhen JLC Technology was founded on November 15, 2006 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
